integrity: Mathematical derivations and packaged exact arithmetic were checked; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats minimum-volume enclosing ellipsoids in the pairwise-comparison Euclidean embedding for n >= 4; it does not treat John ellipsoids, facet structure, or the distinct even-permutation-matrix embedding. Low-dimensional correction identities use exact finite certificates; the n >= 6 statement uses a parity involution. An uncatalogued earlier equivalent treatment remains possible.
title: A sharp parity threshold for the Löwner ellipsoids of linear-ordering polytopes
